technology_name: Low-Cost Piezo-Tribo Hybrid Characterization Instrument for Energy Harvesters
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Optoelectronic Instrumentation Matrix / Material Testing Rig
problem_solved: Standard characterization rigs for hybrid piezoelectric and triboelectric smart materials are highly cost-prohibitive, complex, and lack localized user interfaces to plot immediate multi-parameter electrical outputs.
description: An advanced measurement instrument equipped with a 12-watt D.C. motor, a linear drive shaft, a custom-designed interchangeable test cartridge housing unit, and an automated tertiary sensor array paired with a custom User Interface (UI) module to collect and analyze multi-mode voltage wave signals.
applications: Smart material analysis laboratories, semiconductor prototyping facilities, piezoelectric energy harvester testing setups, and thin-film quality control lines.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
